name: L'Escape, a Luxury Collection Hotel
positioning: Boutique hotel in Seoul's Myeongdong neighborhood (officially L'Escape, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Seoul Myeongdong), with Belle Epoque-inspired interiors by Jacques Garcia
best_for: Travelers who want a design-led boutique base in central Seoul near Namdaemun Market and N Seoul Tower
Longer stays in a suite with a mini kitchen

facts.text: The hotel is a boutique hotel in Seoul's Myeongdong neighborhood, near N Seoul Tower, Namdaemun Market and Deoksu-gung Palace.
The hotel's address is 67 Toegye-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul.
Nearby transport includes Hoehyeon (Namdaemun Market) subway station and Seoul Station.
Rooms blend Belle Epoque charm with modern-day comfort.
The suites include a two-bedroom Presidential Suite.
Marque d'Amour is a high-rise cocktail bar where guests can watch the sunset over creative cocktails.
The Tea Salon, inspired by the salons of France, serves coffee, tea and desserts.
The hotel has event spaces for celebrations, corporate functions and boutique weddings.
The hotel is Green Key certified.

highlights.text: The interiors are by Jacques Garcia, in a Belle Epoque-inspired style that recalls 19th-century Paris.
L'Amant Secret serves French fine dining and wines on the 26th floor, with views.
The top three suite categories feature a mini kitchen, suited to longer stays.
The Swiss Perfection Spa has two treatment rooms and offers bespoke beauty and wellness treatments using Swiss Perfection products.
La Maison Boutique is the hotel's club lounge, with breakfast, Sweet Delight and a curated happy hour.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the bustling urban setting may not appeal to travelers seeking a quiet or secluded retreat.
Guests must be at least 19 to check in.
The La Maison Boutique lounge is for guests 18 and older.
